0022600017.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-4, 14th in the East, 3 games back in the Atlantic) host the Detroit Pistons (3-1, 1st in the East and the Central), with Brooklyn having lost its last four games and Detroit having dropped its most recent one. Tyler Bilodeau is out for Brooklyn with a shoulder sprain, Egor Demin is day-to-day with a bruised leg and is a game-time decision, and Isaiah Joe and Jalen Duren are out for Detroit with a hip bruise and a hamstring strain, respectively. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in their last meeting, on March 10 in Brooklyn, the Nets lost 138-100 in the 2025-26 season, which was also the last time they faced each other in a series, a 3-1 Detroit win.
